Exact App670 / LCD DE3.97 TEST1 simulator source binding
=======================================================
Public firmware source commit: d34ecb44fa058a149b58de2dcbffbb751c015864
https://github.com/bluecyber81/pixl.js/tree/d34ecb44fa058a149b58de2dcbffbb751c015864
Production tree: 2eb76b42aab5a19a6ea90aa371365ced0d238f00
Firmware SourceID: b5da931da1f22110ed60d36af7cfdfda090f5191a070acb6e8c550b8b77eddbe
Linked ARM binding: docs/validation/DE3_97_PFS.json
Engine SHA256: a5aa9c1b7374c77a0a66f44e1287fd5e18f69a43f46797ed74b99e01de631788
WASM SHA256: d77286b2176a369b957b7259305df82da5f950c6e33b3a90ce54c21bf7e8ec4c

The six core/LittleFS files are byte-identical to the frozen LCD App670 build.
Only the CRC loop form changes from App669; the PFS1 geometry, checksums,
generation validation, and read-only protection retain their existing meaning.
The exact simulator is qualified separately from firmware hardware acceptance.
The RAM-only harness and freestanding helpers are retained from App669; the
complete 12-file source set is pinned individually. App669 and older snapshots,
WASM binaries and public source archives remain unchanged.

This freestanding build omits BOARD_LCD and PIXL_TEST_DIAGNOSTICS.
It runs storage operations without SDK timing or GC diagnostic state.
Its core-heap high-water mark is not a measurement of full firmware RAM.
Fresh App669/App670 cross-mount and linked ARM layout/engine checks bind
this modeled filesystem to the final application.

Pinned official WASI SDK 34.0 Linux x86_64 toolchain:
Clang 23.1.0-wasi-sdk / LLVM commit 895aa2c896ada719451be2e3673c83da8ddf1141.
https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/tag/wasi-sdk-34
https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-34/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
Archive SHA256: b761e3a0721dbae9c09a0059e5fdb2bf917d1b4a8a7b430fb3b5aafb0984b2c4
Compiler/linker binary hashes and exact versions: SOURCE_BINDING.json.
The compiler is not included. Verify the archive hash before extracting it.

Reproduce from the root of the extracted source archive:
  python3 web/scripts/build-capacity-de397.py --sdk /path/to/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux --output /path/to/new-evidence-directory
The builder checks compiler/linker hashes and versions, all source hashes,
the engine identity and exact output bytes. SDK default config is disabled.

No device operations are performed. Each real archive and current device
still require the usual migration gates. Host tests do not prove physical
free space, radio speed, power-loss safety or hardware acceptance.
The signed application update is a separate artifact; this WASM never updates
a device. GPL-2.0-LICENSE and LITTLEFS-LICENSE.md are included.
